breakdown.description: The solver is labelled plane stress, but the constitutive relation switches to the unreduced 2D/3D Lamé law
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly specified a plane-stress problem but then provided the constitutive law for plane strain/3D. The ground truth corrected this by asking to use the 'reduced plane-stress constitutive law'. The Agent's generated specification repeated the original error, stating to 'use the full 3-D isotropic stiffness tensor without applying a plane-stress reduction' and providing the incorrect Lamé parameter formula for plane stress.
